caption: The drawing consists of two main rectangular panels placed one above the other, separated by a narrow strip. The upper panel is dark brown with a woodgrain texture and features a symmetrical border design in yellow. This border consists of thin yellow lines and corner decorations with yellow leaf-like shapes; the center of the panel contains three pairs of similar yellow leaf motifs arranged in a circular pattern. Below this, a thin strip shows a repeating yellow semicircular pattern on the same dark brown background. The lower panel is more decorated: its topmost border has a yellowish background featuring clusters of green leaves and red-orange circular or oval shapes resembling fruit. The main part of the lower panel has a dark brown background with a large floral design, including a central orange-red flower with green leaves and additional smaller orange and red shapes. A yellow leaf motif appears in the lower left corner of this panel as well. The overall composition is geometric and decorative, primarily using green, red, orange, yellow, and dark brown colors. The image background is a plain off-white color.
title: Toleware Document Box
